related.description: A library to bring fully animated Material Design components to pre-Lolipop Android.
Material Design implementation for Android 4.0+. Shadows, ripples, vectors, fonts, animations, widgets, rounded corners and more.
Provides 9-patch based drop shadow for view elements. Works on API level 9 or later.
This is a library with components of Android L to you use in android 2.2
[deprecated] Android L Ripple effect wrapper for Views
